Proposition
[The Hodge Star in the Classical Grading]

↗ prop:hodge-star-pointwise ↗ prop:hodge-star-isometry ↗ def:wedge-alternating-forms

For an orthonormal basis and $k+l=n$, the classical star $*:\Lambda ^k(V^*)\to \Lambda ^{n-k}(V^*)$ satisfies \[ \omega \wedge {*}\eta =\langle \omega ,\eta \rangle _e(e^1\wedge \cdots \wedge e^n), \] and is unique and fibrewise isometric.
Proof

\sketch Re-index the block construction along concatenation; the characterization, uniqueness, and isometry transfer from the pointwise star propositions.

□
